Every claim verified: Ryan Realty LLC (founded June 2023, OREA 201253677), Matt PB 201206613, brokers from getBrokers(), CityGrid counts live from geo_snapshot_mv, the founder/fire-service/Red-Erickson story from Matt's verified broker bio.
